focus: 從節理幾何、錨固荷載與量測基準判讀岩坡穩定~Interpret rock slope stability through discontinuity geometry, anchor loads and measurement datums

units.anchor: 節理出露幾何~Discontinuity daylighting geometry
units.title: 節理出露幾何~Discontinuity daylighting geometry
units.mechanism: 平面滑動先受節理方向及坡面幾何控制，節理比坡面緩只是必要幾何條件之一。必須另外確認傾向相近、連續長度、側向釋放面與摩擦，不能把角度差當安全儲備。假設坡面傾角65°、節理傾角40°且傾向一致，幾何角差65−40=25°；此角差不是安全係數，也未檢查楔形或傾倒機制。僅憑一張正面照片量角，會漏掉向側方滑動的楔體；錨索方向若建立在錯誤滑面上，外觀整齊仍不能形成有效的跨面約束。~Planar sliding first depends on discontinuity orientation and slope geometry. A joint flatter than the face meets only one geometric condition. Similar dip direction, persistence, lateral release surfaces and friction also matter; the angular difference is not a stability reserve. Assume a65° face and40° joint with matching dip direction. The angular difference is65−40=25°. It is not a safety factor and does not test wedge sliding or toppling. Angles from a single frontal photograph can miss a laterally sliding wedge. Anchors designed around the wrong plane may look orderly while failing to restrain movement across the actual discontinuity.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設坡面傾角65°、節理傾角40°且傾向一致，幾何角差65−40=25°；此角差不是安全係數，也未檢查楔形或傾倒機制。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: Assume a65° face and40° joint with matching dip direction. The angular difference is65−40=25°. It is not a safety factor and does not test wedge sliding or toppling.
units.verify: 用地質羅盤或定向影像分組記錄節理傾向、傾角及延續性，對照實際坡面建立立體投影。將不可見延伸列成不確定區，由岩土工程師確認控制滑動模式。同時排除以下干擾原因：僅憑一張正面照片量角，會漏掉向側方滑動的楔體；錨索方向若建立在錯誤滑面上，外觀整齊仍不能形成有效的跨面約束。~Group dip directions, dips and persistence using a geological compass or oriented images, then compare them with the actual face on a stereonet. Mark hidden extensions as uncertain and have the geotechnical engineer identify controlling mechanisms. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Angles from a single frontal photograph can miss a laterally sliding wedge. Anchors designed around the wrong plane may look orderly while failing to restrain movement across the actual discontinuity.
units.failure: 僅憑一張正面照片量角，會漏掉向側方滑動的楔體；錨索方向若建立在錯誤滑面上，外觀整齊仍不能形成有效的跨面約束。~Angles from a single frontal photograph can miss a laterally sliding wedge. Anchors designed around the wrong plane may look orderly while failing to restrain movement across the actual discontinuity.
units.misconception: 只要節理出露幾何符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for discontinuity daylighting geometry removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接節理出露幾何時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。用地質羅盤或定向影像分組記錄節理傾向、傾角及延續性，對照實際坡面建立立體投影。將不可見延伸列成不確定區，由岩土工程師確認控制滑動模式。~When handing over discontinuity daylighting geometry, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Group dip directions, dips and persistence using a geological compass or oriented images, then compare them with the actual face on a stereonet. Mark hidden extensions as uncertain and have the geotechnical engineer identify controlling mechanisms.

units.anchor: 孔壓扣除法向力~Pore pressure and normal force
units.title: 孔壓扣除法向力~Pore pressure and normal force
units.mechanism: 岩塊重量分解到滑面後，水壓合力會減少有效接觸力。此處假設單一平面及合力已知，張裂縫水推力與地震慣性需另加，不能混入同一孔壓數字。W=1000kN、滑面角30°、法向水壓合力U=200kN時，N′=Wcos30°−U=666.0kN；正值只表示此模型仍保持壓縮接觸。把坡腳排水孔讀值當作全滑面水壓可高估有效正向力；降雨後上部裂隙仍蓄水時，摩擦抗力可能下降而監測畫面顯示正常。~Resolve block weight normal to the sliding plane before subtracting water thrust. The example assumes one plane and a known resultant; crack-water thrust and seismic inertia require separate terms rather than being hidden inside one pore-pressure value. For W=1000kN, plane angle30° and normal water thrust U=200kN, N′=Wcos30°−U=666.0kN. A positive result only indicates compressive contact in this model. Using a toe-drain reading for the whole plane can overestimate effective normal force; upper fractures may retain storm water and reduce friction while the monitoring display appears normal.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：W=1000kN、滑面角30°、法向水壓合力U=200kN時，N′=Wcos30°−U=666.0kN；正值只表示此模型仍保持壓縮接觸。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For W=1000kN, plane angle30° and normal water thrust U=200kN, N′=Wcos30°−U=666.0kN. A positive result only indicates compressive contact in this model.
units.verify: 將孔壓測點與滑面交會高程一起標示，沿面積分取得水壓合力，再與自由體圖逐項核對。若量測僅在單一裂隙，應保留其他裂隙水力連通的不確定性。同時排除以下干擾原因：把坡腳排水孔讀值當作全滑面水壓可高估有效正向力；降雨後上部裂隙仍蓄水時，摩擦抗力可能下降而監測畫面顯示正常。~Plot piezometer positions with their intersections on the plane, integrate pressure over area and reconcile the resultant with the free-body diagram. A reading in one fracture leaves hydraulic connectivity to other fractures uncertain. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Using a toe-drain reading for the whole plane can overestimate effective normal force; upper fractures may retain storm water and reduce friction while the monitoring display appears normal.
units.failure: 把坡腳排水孔讀值當作全滑面水壓可高估有效正向力；降雨後上部裂隙仍蓄水時，摩擦抗力可能下降而監測畫面顯示正常。~Using a toe-drain reading for the whole plane can overestimate effective normal force; upper fractures may retain storm water and reduce friction while the monitoring display appears normal.
units.misconception: 只要孔壓扣除法向力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for pore pressure and normal force removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接孔壓扣除法向力時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。將孔壓測點與滑面交會高程一起標示，沿面積分取得水壓合力，再與自由體圖逐項核對。若量測僅在單一裂隙，應保留其他裂隙水力連通的不確定性。~When handing over pore pressure and normal force, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Plot piezometer positions with their intersections on the plane, integrate pressure over area and reconcile the resultant with the free-body diagram. A reading in one fracture leaves hydraulic connectivity to other fractures uncertain.

units.anchor: 節理摩擦抗力~Discontinuity friction resistance
units.title: 節理摩擦抗力~Discontinuity friction resistance
units.mechanism: 清潔接觸、充填物與表面粗糙度決定節理的剪切行為，峰值強度不一定能在大位移後維持。模型先忽略黏聚及幾何咬合，以了解有效正向力對摩擦的作用。取N′=666kN、摩擦角φ=30°且c=0，R=N′tanφ=384.5kN，約385kN；此為單一滑面摩擦項，不含錨索與其他外力。試體若避開軟弱充填而只取完整岩面，會高估現場摩擦；初期穩定不能保證剪切後仍保有峰值，滑動可能在雨季反覆累積。~Clean contact, infill and roughness govern discontinuity shear response, and peak strength may not persist after displacement. The model omits cohesion and interlocking to isolate how effective normal force contributes to friction. With N′=666kN, friction angle φ=30° and c=0, R=N′tanφ=384.5kN, about385kN. This is one plane's friction term, excluding anchors and other forces. Samples excluding weak infill can overestimate field friction. Initial stability does not establish persistent peak strength, and repeated wet seasons may accumulate displacement after softening.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：取N′=666kN、摩擦角φ=30°且c=0，R=N′tanφ=384.5kN，約385kN；此為單一滑面摩擦項，不含錨索與其他外力。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With N′=666kN, friction angle φ=30° and c=0, R=N′tanφ=384.5kN, about385kN. This is one plane's friction term, excluding anchors and other forces.
units.verify: 對代表性節理材料做適用的剪切試驗，記錄含水狀態、正向應力及位移範圍。設計審查需明列採用峰值或殘餘值的理由，並和可能位移機制相容。同時排除以下干擾原因：試體若避開軟弱充填而只取完整岩面，會高估現場摩擦；初期穩定不能保證剪切後仍保有峰值，滑動可能在雨季反覆累積。~Test representative joint material under relevant moisture, normal stress and displacement conditions. The design review must explain the choice of peak or residual strength and demonstrate compatibility with the anticipated movement mechanism. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Samples excluding weak infill can overestimate field friction. Initial stability does not establish persistent peak strength, and repeated wet seasons may accumulate displacement after softening.
units.failure: 試體若避開軟弱充填而只取完整岩面，會高估現場摩擦；初期穩定不能保證剪切後仍保有峰值，滑動可能在雨季反覆累積。~Samples excluding weak infill can overestimate field friction. Initial stability does not establish persistent peak strength, and repeated wet seasons may accumulate displacement after softening.
units.misconception: 只要節理摩擦抗力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for discontinuity friction resistance removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接節理摩擦抗力時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。對代表性節理材料做適用的剪切試驗，記錄含水狀態、正向應力及位移範圍。設計審查需明列採用峰值或殘餘值的理由，並和可能位移機制相容。~When handing over discontinuity friction resistance, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Test representative joint material under relevant moisture, normal stress and displacement conditions. The design review must explain the choice of peak or residual strength and demonstrate compatibility with the anticipated movement mechanism.

units.anchor: 錨索方向分量~Anchor force projection
units.title: 錨索方向分量~Anchor force projection
units.mechanism: 錨索拉力必須相對於滑動方向分解，不能把整支拉力全部當直接抗滑。與滑面法向的分量可能改變摩擦，這項效應應獨立計算並避免和直接分量重複。T=200kN與反滑動方向夾角20°時，直接分量Tcos20°=187.9kN，約188kN；額外摩擦項在本式未計。鑽孔偏向使拉力大多沿錯誤方向作用，可能提高局部岩體應力卻未有效抗滑；只驗張力大小而不驗方位，會留下隱藏的支護缺口。~Resolve anchor tension relative to the sliding direction instead of crediting the full force as direct resistance. Its normal component may alter friction, but that contribution must be calculated separately and not double counted with the direct component. For T=200kN at20° to the direction opposing sliding, direct resistance Tcos20°=187.9kN, about188kN. This expression excludes any additional friction term. A deviated borehole may apply most tension in an ineffective direction, raising local stress without sufficient sliding resistance. Verifying force magnitude alone leaves a hidden support deficiency.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：T=200kN與反滑動方向夾角20°時，直接分量Tcos20°=187.9kN，約188kN；額外摩擦項在本式未計。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For T=200kN at20° to the direction opposing sliding, direct resistance Tcos20°=187.9kN, about188kN. This expression excludes any additional friction term.
units.verify: 查驗鑽孔方位、錨頭偏角及滑面幾何，將竣工方向代入向量平衡。用荷載量測比對實際張力，偏斜過大時由設計者重算錨頭彎曲與可用分量。同時排除以下干擾原因：鑽孔偏向使拉力大多沿錯誤方向作用，可能提高局部岩體應力卻未有效抗滑；只驗張力大小而不驗方位，會留下隱藏的支護缺口。~Check drilling azimuth, head deviation and plane geometry, then insert as-built directions into vector equilibrium. Compare measured tension and have the designer reassess head bending and usable components if alignment differs significantly. Also rule out the following competing explanation: A deviated borehole may apply most tension in an ineffective direction, raising local stress without sufficient sliding resistance. Verifying force magnitude alone leaves a hidden support deficiency.
units.failure: 鑽孔偏向使拉力大多沿錯誤方向作用，可能提高局部岩體應力卻未有效抗滑；只驗張力大小而不驗方位，會留下隱藏的支護缺口。~A deviated borehole may apply most tension in an ineffective direction, raising local stress without sufficient sliding resistance. Verifying force magnitude alone leaves a hidden support deficiency.
units.misconception: 只要錨索方向分量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for anchor force projection removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接錨索方向分量時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。查驗鑽孔方位、錨頭偏角及滑面幾何，將竣工方向代入向量平衡。用荷載量測比對實際張力，偏斜過大時由設計者重算錨頭彎曲與可用分量。~When handing over anchor force projection, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Check drilling azimuth, head deviation and plane geometry, then insert as-built directions into vector equilibrium. Compare measured tension and have the designer reassess head bending and usable components if alignment differs significantly.

units.anchor: 穩定區錨固長度~Bond beyond the moving zone
units.title: 穩定區錨固長度~Bond beyond the moving zone
units.mechanism: 固定段必須進入可承受反力的岩體，穿過滑面只是第一個幾何條件。實際黏結長度仍受裂隙、灌漿品質與鄰近錨索互制限制，自由段不得誤算成有效固定段。假設沿錨孔量得總長18m、至不穩定區末端12m，候選穩定區長度18−12=6m；這6m只是可供檢核的長度，不是已證明的黏結容量。固定段若仍位於可移動岩塊中，錨索只是把不穩定塊體互相拉住；表面荷載試驗短期正常也不能證明深部滑面已有可靠反力來源。~The bond zone must enter rock capable of providing reaction. Crossing the plane is only a geometric requirement; fractures, grout quality and anchor interaction limit usable bond length, and the free length is not an effective bond zone. If total bore length is18m and the moving zone ends at12m along that bore, the candidate stable-zone length is18−12=6m. This is available geometry, not demonstrated bond capacity. A bond zone inside the moving block merely connects unstable rock to itself. A short-term satisfactory load test does not demonstrate a dependable reaction beyond the deep failure surface.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設沿錨孔量得總長18m、至不穩定區末端12m，候選穩定區長度18−12=6m；這6m只是可供檢核的長度，不是已證明的黏結容量。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If total bore length is18m and the moving zone ends at12m along that bore, the candidate stable-zone length is18−12=6m. This is available geometry, not demonstrated bond capacity.
units.verify: 對照定向鑽探與灌漿紀錄檢查固定段所在岩層，並以代表性試驗核對荷載、位移及時間效應。發現新滑面時必須重新定位固定段，而非延用原圖。同時排除以下干擾原因：固定段若仍位於可移動岩塊中，錨索只是把不穩定塊體互相拉住；表面荷載試驗短期正常也不能證明深部滑面已有可靠反力來源。~Reconcile oriented bore logs and grouting records with the proposed bond stratum. Representative tests must examine load, movement and time effects; a newly identified sliding plane requires relocating the bond zone rather than relying on old drawings. Also rule out the following competing explanation: A bond zone inside the moving block merely connects unstable rock to itself. A short-term satisfactory load test does not demonstrate a dependable reaction beyond the deep failure surface.
units.failure: 固定段若仍位於可移動岩塊中，錨索只是把不穩定塊體互相拉住；表面荷載試驗短期正常也不能證明深部滑面已有可靠反力來源。~A bond zone inside the moving block merely connects unstable rock to itself. A short-term satisfactory load test does not demonstrate a dependable reaction beyond the deep failure surface.

units.practice: 交接穩定區錨固長度時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。對照定向鑽探與灌漿紀錄檢查固定段所在岩層，並以代表性試驗核對荷載、位移及時間效應。發現新滑面時必須重新定位固定段，而非延用原圖。~When handing over bond beyond the moving zone, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Reconcile oriented bore logs and grouting records with the proposed bond stratum. Representative tests must examine load, movement and time effects; a newly identified sliding plane requires relocating the bond zone rather than relying on old drawings.

units.anchor: 落石位能尺度~Rockfall energy scale
units.title: 落石位能尺度~Rockfall energy scale
units.mechanism: 邊坡錨固與落石防護處理不同機制，不能用整體抗滑通過取代局部塊石控制。位能估算只描述能量來源，碰撞角度、轉動、彈跳及攔截距離決定防護系統需求。岩塊質量m=1000kg、落差h=20m，Ep=mgh=1000×9.81×20=196200J=196.2kJ；未扣除沿途能量損失，也未算衝擊峰值力。把位能直接除以任意短距離作為合格衝擊力，會忽略系統變形與局部穿透；攔網即使標稱能量足夠，位置不對仍可能被彈跳越過。~Anchoring and rockfall protection address different mechanisms. Passing a global sliding check does not control local blocks. Potential energy describes only the energy source; impact angle, rotation, rebound and interception distance determine protective-system demand. For mass m=1000kg and drop h=20m, Ep=mgh=196200J=196.2kJ. The estimate omits energy loss along the path and does not give peak impact force. Dividing energy by an arbitrary short distance ignores deformation and local penetration. Even a nominally adequate barrier can be bypassed by a rebound if its location is unsuitable.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：岩塊質量m=1000kg、落差h=20m，Ep=mgh=1000×9.81×20=196200J=196.2kJ；未扣除沿途能量損失，也未算衝擊峰值力。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For mass m=1000kg and drop h=20m, Ep=mgh=196200J=196.2kJ. The estimate omits energy loss along the path and does not give peak impact force.
units.verify: 由地形測量與塊體尺寸建立可能路徑，將估計能量和經認證系統的適用條件比對。核對攔截位置、殘餘高度及支承狀態，實際評估由落石專業人員核准。同時排除以下干擾原因：把位能直接除以任意短距離作為合格衝擊力，會忽略系統變形與局部穿透；攔網即使標稱能量足夠，位置不對仍可能被彈跳越過。~Use terrain surveys and block dimensions to define trajectories, comparing estimated energy with certified-system conditions. Check interception location, residual height and foundations; a rockfall specialist must approve the actual assessment. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Dividing energy by an arbitrary short distance ignores deformation and local penetration. Even a nominally adequate barrier can be bypassed by a rebound if its location is unsuitable.

units.practice: 交接落石位能尺度時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。由地形測量與塊體尺寸建立可能路徑，將估計能量和經認證系統的適用條件比對。核對攔截位置、殘餘高度及支承狀態，實際評估由落石專業人員核准。~When handing over rockfall energy scale, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Use terrain surveys and block dimensions to define trajectories, comparing estimated energy with certified-system conditions. Check interception location, residual height and foundations; a rockfall specialist must approve the actual assessment.

units.anchor: 排水恢復摩擦~Drainage and friction recovery
units.title: 排水恢復摩擦~Drainage and friction recovery
units.mechanism: 排水主要藉降低裂隙水壓恢復有效正向力，不應以出水量直接換算支護容量。流量下降可能是水位降低，也可能是堵塞，須用孔壓及降雨紀錄辨別。假設水壓合力減少ΔU=100kN、φ=30°且其餘荷載不變，ΔR=ΔUtanφ=57.7kN；未計新增黏聚或錨索作用。排水口暢通但內段被細料阻塞時，表面仍可見少量流出；若缺乏深部孔壓監測，工程師可能錯估摩擦恢復而錯誤減少其他支護需求。~Drainage restores effective normal force by reducing fracture-water pressure; discharge is not itself a support capacity. Falling flow can mean lower water levels or blockage, so pressure and rainfall records are needed to distinguish the causes. If water thrust falls by ΔU=100kN at φ=30° with other loads fixed, ΔR=ΔUtanφ=57.7kN. No added cohesion or anchor force is included. A clear outlet may still pass a little water while its inner section is clogged. Without deep pressure observations, friction recovery can be overstated and other support needs wrongly reduced.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設水壓合力減少ΔU=100kN、φ=30°且其餘荷載不變，ΔR=ΔUtanφ=57.7kN；未計新增黏聚或錨索作用。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If water thrust falls by ΔU=100kN at φ=30° with other loads fixed, ΔR=ΔUtanφ=57.7kN. No added cohesion or anchor force is included.
units.verify: 比較同一場雨前後的降雨、孔壓與排水流量時間序列，檢查滯後及異常高水位。維護驗收以水力反應和設計目標共同判斷，不以單次通水作唯一證據。同時排除以下干擾原因：排水口暢通但內段被細料阻塞時，表面仍可見少量流出；若缺乏深部孔壓監測，工程師可能錯估摩擦恢復而錯誤減少其他支護需求。~Compare rainfall, pressure and discharge time series around the same storm, noting lag and persistent high head. Accept maintenance using hydraulic response and design objectives together rather than a single successful flushing observation. Also rule out the following competing explanation: A clear outlet may still pass a little water while its inner section is clogged. Without deep pressure observations, friction recovery can be overstated and other support needs wrongly reduced.
units.failure: 排水口暢通但內段被細料阻塞時，表面仍可見少量流出；若缺乏深部孔壓監測，工程師可能錯估摩擦恢復而錯誤減少其他支護需求。~A clear outlet may still pass a little water while its inner section is clogged. Without deep pressure observations, friction recovery can be overstated and other support needs wrongly reduced.
units.misconception: 只要排水恢復摩擦符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for drainage and friction recovery removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接排水恢復摩擦時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。比較同一場雨前後的降雨、孔壓與排水流量時間序列，檢查滯後及異常高水位。維護驗收以水力反應和設計目標共同判斷，不以單次通水作唯一證據。~When handing over drainage and friction recovery, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Compare rainfall, pressure and discharge time series around the same storm, noting lag and persistent high head. Accept maintenance using hydraulic response and design objectives together rather than a single successful flushing observation.

units.anchor: 位移量測投影~Displacement measurement projection
units.title: 位移量測投影~Displacement measurement projection
units.mechanism: 感測器測得的是特定方向的位移分量，並不自然等於沿滑面的總位移。解算必須知道移動方向與量測軸，若方向未知則多軸或獨立測量比單軸反推可靠。假設真位移方向與感測軸夾60°、量測投影5mm，d=5/cos60°=10mm；方向已知且剛體移動是此簡化的前提。感測器支座鬆動或滑動方向改變，會使投影關係失效；看似位移減少可能只是方向轉變，錯誤判讀會延誤對加速變形的處置。~A sensor records displacement along its own axis, not automatically the full movement along a plane. Recovery requires the movement direction and measurement axis; unknown directions call for multiple axes or independent surveys rather than one-axis inversion. With a known60° angle between movement and sensor axis and measured projection5mm, d=5/cos60°=10mm. The calculation assumes a known direction and rigid-block movement. A loose sensor support or changed movement direction invalidates projection. An apparent reduction can be a directional change and may delay the planned response to accelerating deformation.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設真位移方向與感測軸夾60°、量測投影5mm，d=5/cos60°=10mm；方向已知且剛體移動是此簡化的前提。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With a known60° angle between movement and sensor axis and measured projection5mm, d=5/cos60°=10mm. The calculation assumes a known direction and rigid-block movement.
units.verify: 先記錄感測器安裝方位，再用全站儀或其他獨立量測比較位移向量。若接近垂直投影造成放大，應報不確定性而非只增加小數位來營造精度。同時排除以下干擾原因：感測器支座鬆動或滑動方向改變，會使投影關係失效；看似位移減少可能只是方向轉變，錯誤判讀會延誤對加速變形的處置。~Record sensor orientation and compare the displacement vector with an independent total-station survey. Near-perpendicular projection amplifies uncertainty; report that uncertainty instead of adding decimal places that imply unsupported precision. Also rule out the following competing explanation: A loose sensor support or changed movement direction invalidates projection. An apparent reduction can be a directional change and may delay the planned response to accelerating deformation.
units.failure: 感測器支座鬆動或滑動方向改變，會使投影關係失效；看似位移減少可能只是方向轉變，錯誤判讀會延誤對加速變形的處置。~A loose sensor support or changed movement direction invalidates projection. An apparent reduction can be a directional change and may delay the planned response to accelerating deformation.
units.misconception: 只要位移量測投影符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for displacement measurement projection removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接位移量測投影時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。先記錄感測器安裝方位，再用全站儀或其他獨立量測比較位移向量。若接近垂直投影造成放大，應報不確定性而非只增加小數位來營造精度。~When handing over displacement measurement projection, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Record sensor orientation and compare the displacement vector with an independent total-station survey. Near-perpendicular projection amplifies uncertainty; report that uncertainty instead of adding decimal places that imply unsupported precision.

units.anchor: 位移速率與時窗~Movement rate and time window
units.title: 位移速率與時窗~Movement rate and time window
units.mechanism: 速率必須和取樣時間窗一起報告，短暫噪聲不能直接當趨勢，長時間平均也可能掩蓋加速。監測觸發值須由場址機制、儀器解析度及回應時間共同制定。假設6h內真位移增加3mm，平均速率v=3/6=0.5mm/h；這不是瞬時速率，也不能直接預測剩餘失穩時間。缺測後把較長間隔誤當正常採樣週期會高估速率；相反，將快速位移攤平到整日可低估加速，兩者都會扭曲應變優先順序。~Report velocity with its observation window. Brief noise is not a trend, while long averaging can hide acceleration. Site mechanisms, sensor resolution and response time must jointly determine monitoring triggers. If displacement increases3mm over6h, average velocity v=3/6=0.5mm/h. This is not instantaneous velocity and cannot directly predict time to failure. Treating a long data gap as a normal interval overstates velocity; averaging a rapid excursion over an entire day understates acceleration. Both distort response priorities and engineering escalation decisions.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設6h內真位移增加3mm，平均速率v=3/6=0.5mm/h；這不是瞬時速率，也不能直接預測剩餘失穩時間。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If displacement increases3mm over6h, average velocity v=3/6=0.5mm/h. This is not instantaneous velocity and cannot directly predict time to failure.
units.verify: 保留原始時間戳、缺測與溫度資料，分別用短窗和長窗檢查趨勢。獨立複測確認異常後依已核准的分級應變表處理，避免臨場任意修改警戒門檻。同時排除以下干擾原因：缺測後把較長間隔誤當正常採樣週期會高估速率；相反，將快速位移攤平到整日可低估加速，兩者都會扭曲應變優先順序。~Retain original timestamps, gaps and temperature records, and compare short and long windows. Independently confirm anomalies and follow the approved graded-response plan rather than changing thresholds ad hoc during an event. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Treating a long data gap as a normal interval overstates velocity; averaging a rapid excursion over an entire day understates acceleration. Both distort response priorities and engineering escalation decisions.
units.failure: 缺測後把較長間隔誤當正常採樣週期會高估速率；相反，將快速位移攤平到整日可低估加速，兩者都會扭曲應變優先順序。~Treating a long data gap as a normal interval overstates velocity; averaging a rapid excursion over an entire day understates acceleration. Both distort response priorities and engineering escalation decisions.
units.misconception: 只要位移速率與時窗符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for movement rate and time window removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接位移速率與時窗時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。保留原始時間戳、缺測與溫度資料，分別用短窗和長窗檢查趨勢。獨立複測確認異常後依已核准的分級應變表處理，避免臨場任意修改警戒門檻。~When handing over movement rate and time window, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Retain original timestamps, gaps and temperature records, and compare short and long windows. Independently confirm anomalies and follow the approved graded-response plan rather than changing thresholds ad hoc during an event.

units.anchor: 錨索長期損失~Long term anchor loss
units.title: 錨索長期損失~Long term anchor loss
units.mechanism: 錨索長期力可因岩土蠕變、鋼材鬆弛、錨頭就位及腐蝕改變，單次初張力不是永久能力。交接應保存基準荷載、量測方法及允許的變化範圍，並指定維護責任。假設可比較的錨索力由250kN降至220kN，損失率=(250−220)/250=12%；比例僅描述量測變化，不能單獨決定是否重新張拉。若腐蝕減少截面卻只補回名義張力，剩餘鋼材應力可能升高；將負荷損失當正常鬆弛會漏掉破損錨頭、失效固定段或深層位移。~Long-term force changes through ground creep, steel relaxation, seating and corrosion; initial tension is not a permanent capacity. Preserve baseline load, measurement method and permitted variation at handover, with an explicit maintenance responsibility. Comparable force readings falling from250kN to220kN give loss=(250−220)/250=12%. This ratio describes change and does not alone authorize retensioning. Restoring nominal tension to a corroded section can raise stress in the remaining steel. Dismissing loss as normal relaxation can miss a damaged head, failed bond zone or deep movement.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設可比較的錨索力由250kN降至220kN，損失率=(250−220)/250=12%；比例僅描述量測變化，不能單獨決定是否重新張拉。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: Comparable force readings falling from250kN to220kN give loss=(250−220)/250=12%. This ratio describes change and does not alone authorize retensioning.
units.verify: 核對量測設備校正及溫度補償，連同位移、滲水與防蝕檢查判讀荷載變化。任何調整荷載方案都由錨固設計與維護工程師確認，先辨別損失來源。同時排除以下干擾原因：若腐蝕減少截面卻只補回名義張力，剩餘鋼材應力可能升高；將負荷損失當正常鬆弛會漏掉破損錨頭、失效固定段或深層位移。~Check calibration and temperature compensation, interpreting force alongside movement, seepage and corrosion observations. Anchor design and maintenance engineers must identify the cause before approving any load-adjustment procedure. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Restoring nominal tension to a corroded section can raise stress in the remaining steel. Dismissing loss as normal relaxation can miss a damaged head, failed bond zone or deep movement.
units.failure: 若腐蝕減少截面卻只補回名義張力，剩餘鋼材應力可能升高；將負荷損失當正常鬆弛會漏掉破損錨頭、失效固定段或深層位移。~Restoring nominal tension to a corroded section can raise stress in the remaining steel. Dismissing loss as normal relaxation can miss a damaged head, failed bond zone or deep movement.
units.misconception: 只要錨索長期損失符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for long term anchor loss removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接錨索長期損失時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。核對量測設備校正及溫度補償，連同位移、滲水與防蝕檢查判讀荷載變化。任何調整荷載方案都由錨固設計與維護工程師確認，先辨別損失來源。~When handing over long term anchor loss, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Check calibration and temperature compensation, interpreting force alongside movement, seepage and corrosion observations. Anchor design and maintenance engineers must identify the cause before approving any load-adjustment procedure.

title: 岩石邊坡錨固與監測~Rock-slope anchoring and monitoring
summary: 本課聚焦從節理幾何、錨固荷載與量測基準判讀岩坡穩定。十個單元依序辨識作用機制、量化假設、驗證程序與故障徵兆，讓學徒追蹤從原始資料到工程判斷的每一環。每個算例都帶單位與限制，不把局部成功或單一比值當成完整系統合格。交接須保留基準、異常與權責工程師核准的條件。~This course focuses on interpret rock slope stability through discontinuity geometry, anchor loads and measurement datums. Ten units connect mechanisms, numerical assumptions, verification procedures and failure symptoms so apprentices can trace each inference from evidence to judgment. Every example includes units and limitations; one successful observation or ratio does not establish system acceptance. Handover retains datums, anomalies and conditions approved by the responsible engineer.
example: 以下為原創教學算例，所有輸入均為假設，不是地標實測。教學假設，非現場設定值：假設坡面傾角65°、節理傾角40°且傾向一致，幾何角差65−40=25°；此角差不是安全係數，也未檢查楔形或傾倒機制。假設坡面65°固定，節理傾角由40°增加10%至44°，角差由25°降至21°，減少4°；這只是傾向一致時的幾何變化，不能稱安全係數降低16%。先列出符號、單位及固定條件，再以獨立計算器核算。敏感度只描述這個模型中的輸入改變；若邊界或物理機制改變，應重建模型而非線性外推。最後把計算值、量測不確定性及需進一步驗證的項目分列，由責任工程師決定能否支持下一階段。~The following original example uses assumptions rather than landmark measurements. Teaching assumptions, not field settings: Assume a65° face and40° joint with matching dip direction. The angular difference is65−40=25°. It is not a safety factor and does not test wedge sliding or toppling. Holding the face at65° while increasing assumed joint dip from40° to44° by10% reduces the angular difference from25° to21°, a4° change; with matching directions this is geometry, not a16% loss of safety factor. First tabulate symbols, units and fixed conditions, then check the arithmetic independently. Sensitivity describes an input change inside this model only. Changed boundaries or physical mechanisms require a new model rather than linear extrapolation. Finally distinguish the calculated result, measurement uncertainty and evidence still needed; the responsible engineer decides whether the conclusion supports a next stage.
history: 本課以公開工程研究與機構文件建立從節理幾何、錨固荷載與量測基準判讀岩坡穩定的背景。寶珊於一九八〇年代設置水平排水改善水位（1980s）。美國聯邦公路管理局出版地錨系統手冊（1999）。香港場地勘察指南列出更新版本（2017）。兩個地標用來比較環境、量測與維護證據，並非宣稱本課每一教學構件都實際用於兩處。來源若只可讀摘要，適用範圍已另行註明；現場設計須重新確認規範版本與責任。本課只重建公開原理。~This course uses public research and institutional documents to establish context for interpret rock slope stability through discontinuity geometry, anchor loads and measurement datums. Horizontal drainage is installed at Po Shan during the1980s (1980s). FHWA publishes its ground-anchor systems manual (1999). Hong Kong lists an updated site-investigation guide (2017). The two landmarks compare environments, measurements and maintenance evidence; they do not imply that every teaching component was installed at both sites. Abstract-only access is declared in source scopes. Field design requires current applicability and responsible review. This course reconstructs public principles only.
facts: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設坡面傾角65°、節理傾角40°且傾向一致，幾何角差65−40=25°；此角差不是安全係數，也未檢查楔形或傾倒機制。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: Assume a65° face and40° joint with matching dip direction. The angular difference is65−40=25°. It is not a safety factor and does not test wedge sliding or toppling.

教學假設，非現場設定值：W=1000kN、滑面角30°、法向水壓合力U=200kN時，N′=Wcos30°−U=666.0kN；正值只表示此模型仍保持壓縮接觸。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For W=1000kN, plane angle30° and normal water thrust U=200kN, N′=Wcos30°−U=666.0kN. A positive result only indicates compressive contact in this model.

教學假設，非現場設定值：取N′=666kN、摩擦角φ=30°且c=0，R=N′tanφ=384.5kN，約385kN；此為單一滑面摩擦項，不含錨索與其他外力。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With N′=666kN, friction angle φ=30° and c=0, R=N′tanφ=384.5kN, about385kN. This is one plane's friction term, excluding anchors and other forces.

教學假設，非現場設定值：T=200kN與反滑動方向夾角20°時，直接分量Tcos20°=187.9kN，約188kN；額外摩擦項在本式未計。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For T=200kN at20° to the direction opposing sliding, direct resistance Tcos20°=187.9kN, about188kN. This expression excludes any additional friction term.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設沿錨孔量得總長18m、至不穩定區末端12m，候選穩定區長度18−12=6m；這6m只是可供檢核的長度，不是已證明的黏結容量。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If total bore length is18m and the moving zone ends at12m along that bore, the candidate stable-zone length is18−12=6m. This is available geometry, not demonstrated bond capacity.

教學假設，非現場設定值：岩塊質量m=1000kg、落差h=20m，Ep=mgh=1000×9.81×20=196200J=196.2kJ；未扣除沿途能量損失，也未算衝擊峰值力。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For mass m=1000kg and drop h=20m, Ep=mgh=196200J=196.2kJ. The estimate omits energy loss along the path and does not give peak impact force.
